title: Fourier weight of a symmetric function
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be invariant under every permutation of its input coordinates. For any natural number $k$ and any subset $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ with $|S|=k$, the total Fourier weight of $f$ at level $k$ equals $\binom{n}{k}$ times the Fourier weight associated with $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is invariant under every permutation of input coordinates
$S$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
